Software Philosophy

Building code that scales gracefully

My programming journey began with foundational systems languages like C++ and Java, where I developed a rigorous understanding of Object-Oriented Programming, memory management, and Data Structures & Algorithms.

After exploring fullstack web development with the MERN stack (MongoDB, Express, React, Node.js), I found my true passion in cross-platform mobile engineering. The ability to craft fluid 60fps and 120fps mobile experiences from a unified Flutter codebase captivated me.

At MindRisers Institute of Technology, I have applied this passion to production apps using Clean Architecture, Riverpod, and Hive. To me, a great app is not just about visual finesse—it is about robust error handling, offline-first reliability, predictable state management, and respecting user device constraints.
